fonction: Retroperitoneal; outer cortex, inner medulla; the renal pelvis collects urine as it forms
Functional unit, over {v:B_NEPHRONS_MILLION} million per kidney: renal corpuscle (glomerulus in the glomerular capsule) + renal tubule (with the nephron loop)
Its thin capillary walls let small molecules, wastes and fluid (mostly water) pass into the tubule
Returns most of the filtered water and solutes to the blood; removes excess acid
Monitors blood pressure and secretes renin
Carries urine from the nephrons to the calyces and renal pelvis
Small tubes, about {v:B_URETERE_CM} cm long; peristalsis moves urine from the renal pelvis to the bladder
Carries urine out of the body; in males, also the passage for sperm
